name: Merge queue: repositories owned by a personal account

attrs.quote: Pull request merge queues are available in any public repository owned by an organization, or in private repositories owned by organizations using GitHub Enterprise Cloud.
attrs.scope: repositories owned by a personal account, public or private: not available
attrs.note: Denied by exclusion from the quoted list: it names only repositories owned by an organization, so a personal account's repositories are not included. The quote names no plan for a personal account.
